meta.name: infinitetalk-shopping-avatar
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者在制作数字人带货视频时，使用本技能可自动生成适配InfiniteTalk的五幕分镜结构化提示词，精准管控角色一致性与音画同步，一键产出高质量9:16竖屏带货视频，让数字人带货更高效！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成数字人五幕分镜，产出竖屏带货视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在运营电商或做内容,需要快速制作数字人带货视频
copy.tagline_en: Generate five-act storyboard prompts for digital human shopping videos.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run e-commerce or create content and need quick digital-human shopping videos.

howto.what: 生成小省导购员数字人带货视频的五幕结构化提示词，每幕含帧级动作时序、场景、音频与光影描述，并输出参数配置表，可直接作为 InfiniteTalk 推理的 prompt 参数。
howto.when: 当你需要制作小省导购员数字人带货视频、要用 InfiniteTalk 模型推理时触发；场景类型为产品推荐、价格对比等时走对应模板。

say.text: 帮我生成产品推荐场景的五幕带货提示词，9:16 竖屏
say.note: 输出五幕提示词与参数配置表

say.text: 核查这套提示词的角色一致性和音画同步
say.note: 给出 pass/fail 报告和问题清单

say.text: 把 Suno 音频做成 16kHz 单声道 wav，每幕对齐 5 秒
say.note: 给出音频编码与对齐说明

howto.what_en: Generates five-scene structured prompts for the Xiaosheng shopping-guide digital human, each with frame-level action timing, scene, audio and lighting notes, plus a parameter table usable as InfiniteTalk's prompt input.
howto.when_en: Use when making a Xiaosheng shopping-guide digital human sales video for InfiniteTalk inference, or when naming a scene type such as product recommendation.

say_en.text: Write five-scene sales prompts for a product-recommendation video, 9:16 vertical.
say_en.note: Returns five prompts and a parameter table.

say_en.text: Check this prompt set for character consistency and audio-video sync.
say_en.note: Gives a pass/fail report with issues.

say_en.text: Make the Suno audio 16kHz mono wav aligned to 5s per scene.
